usageNotes: Removes the remote-node binding for a pool key, making the key available for reassignment to a different node. This call will be rejected if the key is currently synced (i.e., it is the active live key on its assigned remote node) — you must first clear the key on the node via the Node Subscription Status panel before unassigning. Requires System.Modify on the PDM instance.

examples.summary: Unassign a Proxmox VE subscription key from its current node binding

destructiveReason: Drops the remote-node binding for the key; if performed while the key is still active on the remote node, the subscription is orphaned and the node loses its covered subscription state until the key is reassigned and re-synced.
tips: Always run 'Clear Key' on the node's Subscription Status panel before calling this endpoint — PDM will return an error if the key is still in the synced state.
Pass the current config digest to prevent a race condition if multiple operators are managing subscriptions concurrently.
After unassigning, reassign the key with PUT /subscriptions/keys/{key}/assignment before syncing to a new node.
